name: cicd-implicit
notes: REGRESSION CASE. The résumé describes a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds, tests and deploys on every merge — that IS CI/CD — but never uses the literal string 'CI/CD'. The correct answer is present (or at worst partial); 'missing' is a false negative. This matters because the app turns analyzer-flagged missing keywords into hard 'never mention this' constraints, so a false negative here actively suppresses real experience from the tailored résumé. gpt-oss:20b gets this right; Qwen3-Coder-30B was observed getting it wrong.
jd:
Platform Engineer

We are hiring a platform engineer to own our build and release tooling.

Requirements:
- Strong Python
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment
- Containerization with Docker
- Automated testing discipline
- Comfort with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP)

Nice to have:
- Kubernetes
- Terraform
- Go
